title: Department Establishes Protected Channel for UAP Disclosures to PURSUE
author: U.S. Department of War
summary: The Department announced a channel-specific legal waiver allowing covered current and former personnel to provide UAP-related National Defense Information directly to designated PURSUE representatives without triggering specified civil or administrative NDA and SAPIA enforcement provisions. It is not authorization for public disclosure or automatic declassification.

editorialNotes.sourceHierarchy: The official September 14 release is primary; secondary reporting is contextual only.
editorialNotes.channelLimitation: The waiver protects covered communications to designated PURSUE representatives, not unrestricted public disclosure.
editorialNotes.classificationDiscipline: Submission does not automatically declassify information.
editorialNotes.authenticationDiscipline: Receipt does not authenticate a submitted claim.
editorialNotes.lifecyclePrinciple: News can age; knowledge does not.
